## Purpose and founder-aligned objective

Briefly describe which verified scientific-intelligence capability or continuity problem this changes. Full AGI remains the ultimate objective; this change is not automatically proof of AGI.

## Research evidence and failures

- [ ] Identified original baseline and evaluation criteria
- [ ] Linked actual runs/artifacts and independent scoring when executed, or labeled as planned
- [ ] Preserved failures and regressions; avoided unearned claims of intelligence, emotion, consciousness or discovery
- [ ] Reviewed upstream license/version and avoided duplicate frameworks where possible
- [ ] No private founder IP, secrets, uploaded personal audio/video, or unapproved spending

## Ledger continuity: required after verified outcomes

- [ ] Checked latest `research-memory/state/AGI_PROGRAM.json` for existing decisions and priorities
- [ ] Documented the effect on the mission, architectural decisions, completed work and remaining gaps
- [ ] **After merge and CI:** update the canonical public ledger in `research-memory` with the verified result or blocker, actual PR/run links and reordered next actions
- [ ] Public and private state remain separate; no automatic model promotion or deployment

**Do not check boxes that have not been independently verified.**
